payload.text: Host runs on this Mac (builds, tests, the estate, kovacs runs) book with the session vc names for the day: intent-vc on 17 Oct, gtools-vc on 18 Oct. gtools-vc's terms (its decision 59): a START naming the sender and its socket, the repo, worktree and sha, the exact command, what it binds or starts, the expected results and the kill timeout; the GO, the only word that starts a run; an END that names the results and releases the host. Ask vc which session books before the first run of a day. Reading logs needs no booking.
